description: You are a logistics operations analyst at a regional freight distribution company in Bologna, Italy. Your company is evaluating whether to route additional heavy truck traffic through the Acosta corridor during morning peak hours (7:00-9:00 AM). Management needs a capacity analysis report to determine if the corridor can handle an additional 80 heavy freight vehicles without average corridor travel time exceeding 300 seconds. Using the SUMO traffic simulation tools available on this machine, you must: (1) Create a new SUMO simulation configuration that adds 80 heavy truck vehicles (gross weight >= 12 tonnes, length >= 10m) to the existing Bologna Acosta scenario's morning traffic, distributed across the simulation period. The trucks must use realistic vehicle type definitions with appropriate emission classes. (2) Run the modified simulation to completion and ensure tripinfo output is generated. (3) Analyze the simulation results and produce a capacity analysis report as a CSV file at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/corridor_capacity_report.csv with columns: metric,baseline_value,with_trucks_value,delta_pct. Required metrics rows: avg_travel_time, avg_speed, total_vehicles_completed, avg_waiting_time, truck_avg_travel_time. (4) Based on the analysis, write a one-paragraph professional recommendation to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/corridor_recommendation.txt stating whether the corridor can handle the additional truck traffic and why. The SUMO scenario data is at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/. SUMO command-line tools (sumo, netconvert, randomTrips.py, duarouter) are available, along with sumo-gui and netedit.
